visual_identity.core_identity: An ancient skeletal spellcaster preserved by forbidden magic, combining unmistakable undead anatomy with deliberate arcane intelligence.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall robed skeletal humanoid with narrow shoulders, exposed skull and hands, one spellcasting arm raised, robes falling in simple vertical shapes.
visual_identity.head_features: Bare or partly hooded skull with deep empty sockets or small magical pinpoints, intact jaw, severe ancient profile.
visual_identity.body_shape: Dry skeletal humanoid frame under decayed layered robes, bony hands visible, upright commanding posture.
visual_identity.surface: Clean bone planes and torn fabric edges; no gore, slime, or dense decay.

accuracy_checks: skull and hands are clearly skeletal

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
